item.title: Lakeshore Health Ransomware Attack Disrupts Hospital Systems in Three States
item.description: Hospitals in three states are diverting ambulances after a ransomware attack on Lakeshore Health.

item.title: Fabrikam Confirms Exploitation of SCADA Gateway Zero-Day
item.description: Fabrikam says CVE-2026-90021 in its SG-500 gateway was exploited as a zero-day.

item.title: Northwind Cloud Outage Blamed on Faulty Configuration Update
item.description: A six-hour outage at Northwind Cloud was caused by a faulty configuration update, not a cyberattack, the company said. Customers in two regions lost access to storage and virtual machines.

item.title: Email Security Startup Raises $40 Million in Series B Funding
item.description: An email security startup has raised $40 million to expand its detection platform. The company plans to double its engineering team by next year.
